author: claude-opus-5-5
visual_review: Inspected 48px and 384px in light and dark: a domed head with a single round eye over a boxy body, arms curving down from the shoulders and two legs with feet; reads as a friendly robot. A first version with a narrow dome and a chest dot (attempts/v1-padlock-look.svg) read as a padlock. The rejected drawing merged head and body into one capsule with a lone dot.
omissions: The reference's smile, chest slot and button, ball hands and outlined legs are simplified: the dome can hold one feature 8 from its outline (a single eye), the 10-tall body holds none, hands are round caps and legs are strokes.
drawing_plan: SQUARE, symmetric about x=24: dome r9 about (24,15) with sides flaring to (14,24)/(34,24); eye dot (24,15); body rectangle x14..34 y24..34; arms r8 quarter arcs to x6/42 then down to y38; legs x19/29 to y42 with outward feet.
lucide_reference: Lucide 'bot' (rounded head on a rectangular body).
